hypothesis: Increasing the calibration data fraction provides a more robust threshold estimate, which is critical when relying heavily on the direct evaluator.
rationale: At a 0.90 direct-eval weight, the final performance is highly sensitive to the precise threshold chosen during calibration. Increasing the training data slice dedicated to calibration from 15% to 20% should improve threshold stability without noticeably degrading the CFR prior, which is already de-emphasized.
